card.title: The Designated Translator
card.instruction: Return automatically to explaining rules, smoothing procedures, and answering questions before anyone asks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your visitor badge. The blue lift skips reception; lunch vouchers are inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Left of the lift. Take the badge; the door locks behind you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Give him this spare badge before you go in, or he'll need someone to hold it for him.

mechanism: A automatically supplies access and lunch details, answers the toilet question and anticipates the door-holder's next badge problem.
confusable: Unlike controlling access for leverage, A habitually smooths procedures and supplies the next answer before anyone asks.
comparison: The visitor alternative anticipates a second person's exit difficulty; the family-shopping alternative anticipates substitutions even after a photo solves identification.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
